commit.title: AP-13/#247 (IPinningPolicy-Teil, v1): host-seitiges Mess-Thread-Pinning (--pin-core=N), ABI-4, golden-neutral
commit.message:
AP-13/#247 (IPinningPolicy-Teil, v1): host-seitiges Mess-Thread-Pinning (--pin-core=N), ABI-4, golden-neutral

Opt-in Core-Index-Pinning des single-threaded Mess-Threads -> Varianz-Reduktion auf Hybrid-CPUs (P/E-Cores).
Default no-op; beruehrt weder POD/binary_id/golden noch die 16/25-CSV-Spalten (analog AP-9/AP-1). Getrennt von
platform::IPinningPolicy (Modell-Ebene) -> distinkter Host-Applier im builder-Namespace.
- builder/measurement/thread_pinning.hpp: ScopedThreadPin (RAII, SetThreadAffinityMask/sched_setaffinity,
  #ifdef-guarded, else no-op; WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN + NOMINMAX) + NoPinPolicy (Default) + CorePinPolicy.
- f15_compare: --pin-core=N (Default no-op).
- test_ap13_thread_pinning: NeutralityGuards (ABI-4/sizeof-1416/CSV-25/pipeline16-16) + NoPin-no-op +
  CorePin(0)-Round-Trip (Maske setzen+restaurieren, plattform-guarded).

Lokal MSVC literal [ PASSED ] 3 tests (Round-Trip before=0xFFFF pinned=0x1 restored=0xFFFF); f15_compare baut gruen.
AUFGESCHOBEN: P/E-Core-Auto-Erkennung (CPUID 0x1A) + 3-ISA-Build-Matrix (reuse-gated); perm_runner-Pinning verworfen.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
